label: If some pair compares in the supplied esse respect, some in-act…, by Well-founded induction with…
meaning: If something is more a being than something, it has being (more such has the perfection). From any bearer of being climb by 'more in being': each step reaches a bearer, and by the OPEN ascent bound the climb ends at a bearer that nothing exceeds in being, a maximum in being. Excluded middle decides at each bearer whether anything exceeds it. The maximum need not be unique, greatest, or a cause.
